weixin.intro.zh: 用微信扫码绑定官方 ClawBot（iLink）通道。绑定后，账号收到的微信消息会进入对应的 Kairos 项目，由该项目的 agent 回复。
weixin.intro.en: Scan with WeChat to bind the official ClawBot (iLink) channel. Once bound, messages your account receives are routed to a Kairos project and answered by its agent.

weixin.scanHint.zh: 用微信扫码，并在手机上确认登录
weixin.scanHint.en: Scan with WeChat and confirm the login on your phone

weixin.zoomHint.zh: 点一下二维码可以放大
weixin.zoomHint.en: Click the QR code to enlarge it

weixin.status.scaned.zh: 已扫码，请在手机上确认

weixin.status.needVerifycode.zh: 需要在手机上输入下面的配对数字
weixin.status.needVerifycode.en: Enter the pairing number shown on your phone

weixin.status.verifyBlocked.zh: 验证码多次错误，已重新生成二维码
weixin.status.verifyBlocked.en: Too many wrong codes - a new QR code was generated

weixin.status.redirect.zh: 正在切换服务器，请稍候…

weixin.verifyPlaceholder.en: Enter the number from your phone

weixin.deleteConfirm.zh: 删除这个账号？对应的绑定和同步游标也会一起清掉。
weixin.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this account? Its bindings and sync cursor are removed too.

weixin.error.qr.en: Failed to get the QR code

weixin.error.status.en: Failed to get the scan status

weixin.error.accounts.en: Failed to load the account list
